From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Request to open replacement headcount — Inference Runtime Engineer

Hi team,

I'm requesting approval to open a replacement headcount for an Inference Runtime Engineer (IC-3) on the Serving runtime team. Jose (on my team) accepted an external offer effective 9/3; we need to launch a req to avoid gaps in on-call coverage and the upcoming Q4 rollout. Key details below:

- Role: Inference Runtime Engineer (IC-3)
- Reason: Backfill (voluntary departure) — preserve on-call and deployment ownership
- Target start window: late September–early October
- Proposed hiring timeline: post req approval, 2-week sourcing, 2 technical screens, on-site / loop in week 4
- Compensation band: $160k–$190k (target midpoint); will confirm with People/Comp if we greenlight

Attachments: role_description_v2.pdf (updated JD), cost_summary_q3.xlsx (budget impact)

Ask:
1) Approval to open the req and convert to an active posting on our ATS (req RI-3421) by EOD 8/18
2) Enable priority recruiter assignment and 4 interviewers to be reserved on calendars for late-Aug panels
3) Signoff on the compensation band or direction to engage People for a waiver

Why this is urgent: two planned infra deployments rely on Jose's operational knowledge; without a backfill we will need to reassign on-call which will risk slower incident response and slower rollout validation.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Staff Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Rafael,

I support opening this as a backfill in principle given the operational risk you outlined. A couple quick items before I formally greenlight:

- Confirm the compensation band with People & Legal. If midpoint is above our standard band for IC-3, I will need a short justification (scope, on-call criticality).
- Can you confirm interview panel members (HM + 3 technical interviewers) and whether we need an on-call practical? If we do, we'll schedule a hands-on troubleshooting exercise.
- Please include the expected interview timeline in the ATS req so Recruiters can prioritize outreach.

If you can send the panel names and final band by EOD today, I'll approve and loop Finance for the headcount entry.

Marissa
